blocks.content:
CBI can investigate cases involving:
• Corruption and bribery
• Economic crimes
• Special crimes such as terrorism or major fraud
• Cases ordered by High Courts or the Supreme Court
Cases ordered by High Courts or the Supreme Court

items: Remember that CBI can take up cases ordered by both High Courts and the Supreme Court.
Special crimes investigated by CBI include terrorism and major fraud alongside corruption and economic crimes.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: CBI investigates cases related to corruption and bribery.
Economic offenses and major financial frauds fall under CBI's jurisdiction.
Special high-profile crimes, including terrorism, are investigated by the CBI.
The Supreme Court and High Courts can directly order CBI investigations.
